description: Defines the ArrayCollectionModel class in the OrangeHRM Core API v2, which encapsulates an array of data and provides a method to convert it to an array.

classes.name: ArrayCollectionModel
classes.description: A model class that encapsulates an array of data and implements normalization via the CollectionNormalizable interface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ArrayCollectionModel with an array of data.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the stored data as an array.
